name: codebase-design
title: Codebase Design
summary: Design deep modules — small interfaces over real behavior, at clean seams, testable through the interface.

use_when: Designing a module's interface or deciding where a seam belongs
Evaluating whether an abstraction earns its place
A review or test-design discussion needs precise module vocabulary
Making code more testable or easier for agents to navigate
avoid_when: Domain terminology is the problem — use domain-modeling
